title: People: physical appearance
about: Collocations for describing how people look: the shape of the face and nose, hair, figure and build, and someone's overall appearance, such as a round face, shoulder-length hair, broad shoulders and a striking appearance.

parts.title: Tip
parts.note: Деякі слова мають дуже вузьку сполучуваність. Blonde, ginger і auburn (рудувато-каштановий) кажуть про волосся людини, а не про одяг чи речі; ginger ще кажуть про котів: a ginger cat. Fair у цьому значенні — тільки про волосся і шкіру. В українській так само: сивим буває волосся, а шарф — сірий. Такі слова записуй у словник разом із тим, з чим вони вживаються.

items.pattern: a round face · round-faced
items.meaning: a face that is wide and curved, almost like a circle
items.example: With her **round face** and rosy cheeks, my aunt always looks cheerful, even when she's tired.
more: Short fringes and soft curls look lovely on a **round face**.
He's got a **round face** and a big smile, and children love him.

items.pattern: a droopy moustache · droopy ears / eyelids
items.meaning: a moustache with long ends that hang down heavily
items.example: Grandad has had the same **droopy moustache** since the 1970s, and we can't imagine him without it.
more: He shaved off his **droopy moustache** for the wedding, and his own kids didn't recognise him.
By midnight the baby's eyelids were **droopy**, and she was almost asleep.
items.watchOut: Вуса однієї людини — одне слово в однині: a moustache (US — mustache). His moustache is grey, а не his moustaches are. Наголос на другий склад: /məˈstɑːʃ/.

items.pattern: a pointed face / chin / nose
items.meaning: a face that gets narrower towards the chin, almost ending in a point
items.example: The boy who played the fox in the school play had a small, **pointed face** that was perfect for the part.
more: Her daughter has the same small, **pointed face** and big brown eyes.
My sister has a **pointed** chin, just like our dad.
items.watchOut: «Гостре» обличчя чи підборіддя — pointed (розмовне — pointy), а не acute: acute — гострий про біль, кут чи проблему.

items.pattern: a straight nose · straight hair / teeth
items.meaning: a nose that does not bend or curve
items.example: In the old family portrait, everyone has the same **straight nose**, from the grandparents to the baby.
more: The twins look alike, but Mia has a **straight nose** and Lily's turns up a little at the end.
You've got such **straight** teeth! Did you wear a brace?
items.watchOut: Прямий ніс — straight, а не direct: direct — прямий у значенні «без пересадок, безпосередній» (a direct flight). Straight hair — пряме, не кучеряве волосся.

items.pattern: an oval face · an oval mirror / table
items.meaning: a face shaped like an egg: a little longer than it is wide, with a curved chin
items.example: My hairdresser says almost any style suits an **oval face**.
more: In the portrait, the young woman has a pale **oval face** and a long neck.
We hung an **oval** mirror above the fireplace.
items.watchOut: Наголос на перший склад: O-val /ˈəʊvl/, а не о-ВАЛ, як в українському «овал». Перед ним — an: an oval face.

items.pattern: an upturned nose · also a turned-up nose
items.meaning: a nose whose end points slightly upwards
items.example: Their daughter has freckles and a cute **upturned nose**.
more: Lots of babies have **upturned noses** that change shape as they grow.
The boat lay **upturned** on the beach, waiting to be painted.
items.watchOut: Upturned nose — це лише форма носа. «Задирати носа» (зверхньо поводитися) — інше: be stuck-up або have your nose in the air. An upturned boat — перевернутий догори дном човен.

items.pattern: a slim figure / build · be / stay slim
items.meaning: a body that is thin in an attractive, healthy way
items.example: These jeans are cut for people with a **slim figure**, so they're too tight on me.
more: She's tall and **slim**, with short grey hair.
The dress looked lovely on her **slim figure**.
items.watchOut: Slim — комплімент. Thin — нейтральне, але може означати «занадто худий»; skinny — розмовне й часто неприємне (худющий). Тож людині краще сказати: You look slim.

items.pattern: a slender waist / neck / fingers · rather formal, poetic
items.meaning: a waist that is narrow and graceful
items.example: The old photo shows Great-Grandma in a long skirt, with a **slender waist** and her hair piled up high.
more: She wore her grandmother's ring on one **slender** finger.
Tall, **slender** trees lined the road to the village.
items.watchOut: Тонка талія — a slender або slim waist. Fine — «тонкий» про волосся чи нитку (fine hair), а про талію так зазвичай не кажуть. Slender звучить книжно й поетично; у розмові частіше slim.

items.pattern: a lovely / clear / pale / fair / dark complexion
items.meaning: the natural colour and quality of the skin on someone's face, when it looks healthy and attractive
items.example: Grandma never sunbathed, and at eighty she still has a **lovely complexion**.
more: Drinking more water has really helped my **complexion**.
This foundation is made for a **fair complexion** like mine.
items.watchOut: Хибний друг: complexion — колір і стан шкіри обличчя, а не комплекція. Комплекція, статура — build: a man of medium build.

items.pattern: sleek hair · a sleek coat (of an animal)
items.meaning: hair that is smooth, shiny and lies flat
items.example: After the hairdresser had finished, my hair was **sleek** and shiny for the first time in years.
more: She always wears her **sleek** dark hair in a low ponytail.
Our neighbour's cat has a **sleek** black coat.
items.watchOut: Не плутай sleek і slicked-back: sleek hair — гладеньке й блискуче, це комплімент; slicked-back hair — зачесане назад і прилизане гелем.

items.pattern: shoulder-length / chin-length / waist-length hair
items.meaning: hair that comes down as far as your shoulders
items.example: For the wedding, she had her **shoulder-length hair** curled.
more: I've had my hair cut **chin-length** for the summer.
My son wants to grow his hair **shoulder-length**, like his favourite guitarist.
items.watchOut: «До плечей» — shoulder-length hair, а не shoulder-long і не hair to shoulders. Так само chin-length, waist-length. Можна сказати й інакше: Her hair comes down to her shoulders.

items.pattern: immaculately / well / perfectly groomed · immaculately dressed
items.meaning: with hair, clothes and nails that are always very neat and looked after with great care
items.example: The receptionist was **immaculately groomed**: perfect nails, a neat bun and a spotless white shirt.
more: Even on a camping holiday, my aunt manages to look **immaculately groomed**.
Before the interview he made sure he was **well groomed**: a fresh shave and an ironed shirt.
items.watchOut: «Ідеально доглянута» — immaculately або perfectly groomed, а не ideally groomed: ideally — «в ідеалі». Groom як іменник — наречений (bridegroom).

items.pattern: coarse hair / wool / sand
items.meaning: rough and thick, not smooth or soft
items.example: I have thick, **coarse** hair, so I need a strong brush and lots of conditioner.
more: Grandad's beard is grey and **coarse**, and it tickles when he kisses us.
We walked barefoot across the **coarse** sand to the sea.
items.watchOut: Жорстке волосся — coarse hair, а не hard чи rude hair. Coarse вимовляється так само, як course: /kɔːs/. Про жарти чи мову coarse — грубий, вульгарний.

items.pattern: broad shoulders / hips / back
items.meaning: shoulders or hips that are wide
items.example: My brother has **broad shoulders**, so he finds it hard to buy jackets that fit.
more: All the women in my family have **broad hips** and long legs.
Years of swimming have given her **broad shoulders** and strong arms.
items.watchOut: Про плечі зазвичай кажуть broad: broad shoulders, a broad back; про стегна — і broad, і wide hips. Hips — стегна як ширина фігури (там, де тримається пояс); частина ноги над коліном — thighs.

items.pattern: be well-built · a well-built man · also strongly built
items.meaning: having a big, strong, attractive body
items.example: The new PE teacher is tall and **well-built**, and he used to play rugby.
more: My cousin is a **well-built** young man who works on a farm.
He's quite **well-built** for a fourteen-year-old.
items.watchOut: Про людей кажуть well-built (не good-built), частіше про чоловіків. Статура — build: of medium / slim / heavy build. Про будинок well-built — добре збудований.

items.pattern: go / be going bald · go – went – gone
items.meaning: start to lose the hair on the top of your head
items.example: My uncle started **going bald** at twenty-five and decided to shave his head.
more: Dad's hair is thinning on top, but he isn't **going bald** yet.
Lots of men **go bald**, and plenty of them look great.
items.watchOut: Лисіти — go bald: He's going bald. Become bald граматично можливо, але звучить книжно. Bald вимовляється /bɔːld/, як ball + d; bold /bəʊld/ — сміливий.

items.pattern: a youthful appearance / face / figure · look youthful
items.meaning: looking young, often younger than you really are
items.example: My aunt is nearly sixty, but she has such a **youthful appearance** that people often guess she's in her forties.
more: The singer is in her fifties but still has a **youthful** face and voice.
With his trainers and **youthful** grin, our new head teacher looks like a student.
items.watchOut: Моложавий — youthful, а не youngish: youngish означає «ще доволі молодий» (про вік, а не про вигляд). Juvenile — дитячий, незрілий, звучить негативно.

items.pattern: thick hair / eyebrows / beard · ↔ thin / fine hair
items.meaning: a lot of hair growing close together
items.example: My daughter has such **thick hair** that it takes twenty minutes to dry.
more: In the photo from the 1980s, Dad still has **thick** dark hair.
Wool hats are too warm for me: I've got really **thick hair**.
items.watchOut: Густе волосся — thick hair; dense hair у розмові майже не кажуть. Протилежне — thin hair (рідке) або fine hair (тонке).

items.pattern: bushy eyebrows / beard / moustache / tail
items.meaning: very thick eyebrows that grow in all directions
items.example: Our maths teacher raises his **bushy eyebrows** whenever someone gives a silly answer.
more: Grandad's white eyebrows are so **bushy** that he looks like a wizard.
A squirrel with a **bushy** tail ran across the path.

items.pattern: chubby cheeks / legs / fingers · a chubby baby
items.meaning: round and slightly fat cheeks, in a sweet, attractive way
items.example: Our baby has **chubby cheeks** and the loudest laugh in the family.
more: In my first school photo, I've got **chubby cheeks** and no front teeth.
Look at those **chubby** little fingers covered in chocolate!
items.watchOut: Chubby — ласкаве слово, особливо про дітей. Про дорослого (a chubby man) може прозвучати не дуже ввічливо. Порівняй тон: plump — м'яко, overweight — нейтрально, як у лікаря, fat — прямо й часто грубо.

items.pattern: dark hair / eyes / skin · dark-haired
items.meaning: hair that is black or dark brown
items.example: Both my parents have **dark hair**, so everyone was surprised when I was born blonde.
more: She's a tall woman with short **dark hair** and glasses.
My brother's **dark hair** has a few grey streaks now.
items.watchOut: Brown hair — це каштанове або темно-русяве волосся, а не «коричневе». Жінку з темним волоссям часто називають a brunette.

items.pattern: jet-black hair / eyes / fur
items.meaning: completely black and shiny
items.example: I dyed my hair **jet-black** for a Halloween party, and it took weeks to wash out.
more: Their puppy is **jet-black** apart from one white paw.
In her wedding photo, Grandma has **jet-black hair** and bright red lipstick.
items.watchOut: Jet тут — не реактивний літак, а гагат, чорний блискучий камінь. Перед іменником пишуть з дефісом: jet-black hair.

items.pattern: go / turn grey · greying hair · go – went – gone
items.meaning: your hair becomes grey or white, usually as you get older
items.example: My mum **went grey** in her thirties and decided never to dye her hair.
more: Teaching thirty teenagers is enough to make anyone **go grey**!
His beard is starting to **go grey** at the sides.
items.watchOut: Посивіти — go grey або turn grey (UK grey, US gray). White hair — це дуже сиве волосся, а не біляве.

items.pattern: fair hair / skin · fair-haired · also blonde / blond hair
items.meaning: hair that is light in colour: pale yellow or light brown
items.example: Our little boy has **fair hair** that goes almost white in the summer sun.
more: A pale blue shirt looks lovely with **fair** skin and hair.
She's tall and **fair-haired**, so you'll easily spot her at the station.
items.watchOut: Fair тут — світлий, а не «справедливий». Біляве волосся — fair або blonde hair; white hair — сиве. Blonde частіше пишуть про жінок, blond — про чоловіків і в американській англійській.

items.pattern: ginger / red hair · a ginger cat · auburn hair = reddish brown
items.meaning: hair of a red or orange-brown colour
items.example: Our new neighbour has bright **ginger hair** and lots of freckles.
more: All three of their children have **ginger hair**, just like their grandad.
The shop assistant had **auburn** hair, a lovely reddish brown.
items.watchOut: Рудий — ginger або red (red hair, a redhead), а не rude: rude — грубий! Ginger — про волосся (і котів), а про одяг кажуть orange. У Британії ginger часом звучить як дражнилка, тож про людину нейтральніше red-haired.

items.pattern: short and dumpy · a short, dumpy woman · slightly negative
items.meaning: short and quite fat; used more often about women, and it can sound a little unkind
items.example: In the cartoon, the fairy godmother is **a short, dumpy woman** with a magic wand and a very kind smile.
more: I love this coat, but it makes me look **short and dumpy**.
The story's heroine is a **short, dumpy** woman with a huge heart and a brilliant mind.
items.watchOut: Dumpy звучить трохи зневажливо, тож людині в очі так не кажуть. М'якше: a bit plump, on the plump side. Про себе з гумором — можна.

items.pattern: a portly gentleman / man · of middle-aged and older men
items.meaning: a middle-aged or older man who is fat and round, often said in a polite or humorous way
items.example: A **portly gentleman** in a tweed jacket offered me his seat on the train.
more: Our village butcher is a jolly, **portly** man with a big moustache.
Grandad has got a bit **portly** since he retired, so he's taken up walking.
items.watchOut: Portly — ввічливе, трохи старомодне й жартівливе слово про чоловіків середнього й старшого віку. Про жінок і молодь так зазвичай не кажуть.

items.pattern: a lanky youth / teenager / boy · tall and lanky
items.meaning: a young man who is tall and thin and tends to move awkwardly
items.example: A **lanky youth** in a school blazer helped me carry my suitcase up the station steps.
more: My nephew has grown so fast that he's suddenly **tall and lanky**.
**Lanky** teenagers often look a bit awkward until the rest of their body catches up.
items.watchOut: Youth як злічуваний іменник — юнак, підліток (у новинах часто з негативним відтінком: a gang of youths). Незлічуване youth — молодість: in my youth.

items.pattern: dishevelled hair / clothes · look dishevelled
items.meaning: very untidy (of hair, clothes or someone's appearance)
items.example: He'd slept on the overnight bus and arrived with **dishevelled hair** and a creased shirt.
more: I'd just woken up and answered the door in my pyjamas, completely **dishevelled**.
My teenage son always looks a bit **dishevelled**, but he's a lovely boy.
items.watchOut: Вимова /dɪˈʃevld/: наголос на другий склад, di-SHEV-elled. Британське написання — dishevelled (два l), американське — disheveled.

items.pattern: bear a striking / strong / close resemblance to sb · bear little resemblance to sb · bear – bore – borne
items.meaning: look remarkably like someone or something
items.example: The woman in the bakery **bears a striking resemblance to** my old geography teacher.
more: The new shopping centre **bears a strong resemblance to** an airport.
The twins **bear little resemblance to** each other.
items.watchOut: Схожість з кимось — resemblance to, а не on: She bears a resemblance to her aunt. Дієслово resemble — без прийменника: She resembles her aunt (не resembles to / on).

items.pattern: have a striking appearance · a striking face / woman · look striking
items.meaning: look unusual and attractive, so that people notice you
items.example: With her silver hair and bright red glasses, my aunt **has a very striking appearance**.
more: He's not exactly handsome, but he **has a striking appearance** that people remember.
The bride looked **striking** in a dark green dress.
items.watchOut: «Яскрава зовнішність» — a striking appearance, а не a bright appearance: bright — про колір, світло чи розум (a bright child — тямуща дитина). Striking тут — позитивне: незвичайна й приваблива.

warmup.explain: Колір і стан шкіри обличчя — complexion. Build — статура, комплекція.

warmup.q: My dad has started to ___ bald.
warmup.explain: Лисіти — go bald; посивіти — go grey.

warmup.uk: У нього прямий ніс і густі брови.
warmup.q: He has a ___ nose and thick eyebrows.
warmup.explain: Прямий ніс — a straight nose. Direct — прямий у значенні «безпосередній»: a direct flight.

warmup.uk: У хлопчика руде волосся й веснянки.
warmup.q: The boy has ___ hair and freckles.
warmup.explain: Руде волосся — ginger або red hair; a redhead — руда людина (іменник). Rude — грубий.

warmup.uk: Вона разюче схожа на свою тітку.
warmup.q: She bears a striking resemblance ___ her aunt.
warmup.explain: Resemblance to sb. А дієслово resemble — без прийменника: She resembles her aunt.

warmup.uk: У неї дуже яскрава, ефектна зовнішність.
warmup.explain: Яскрава зовнішність — a striking appearance. Bright — про колір чи світло.

A.q: Too much sugar can be bad for your ___, as well as your teeth.
A.explain: Complexion — колір і стан шкіри обличчя. Комплекція, статура — build.

A.q: Lots of footballers shave their heads when they start ___ bald.
A.explain: Лисіти — go bald: he's going bald.

A.q: My hair is so ___ that it feels like straw.
A.explain: Coarse — жорсткий, грубий на дотик. Sleek — навпаки, гладенький і блискучий; rude — грубий про поведінку.

B.q: He'd been gardening all morning and came in with ___ hair and muddy knees.
B.explain: Dishevelled — скуйовджений, неохайний. Groomed і sleek — навпаки: доглянутий, гладенький.

B.q: My sister ___ a striking resemblance to our mum when she was young.
B.explain: Бути схожим на когось — bear a resemblance to sb.

B.q: With his long white hair and black cloak, the magician had a very ___ appearance.
B.explain: Яскрава, ефектна зовнішність — a striking appearance. Bright — про колір чи світло.

example.title: The photo album
example.uk:
Минулої неділі бабуся показала мені старий фотоальбом. На першій сторінці був мій прадідусь — огрядний пан із довгими обвислими вусами й доброю усмішкою. Поруч із ним стояла бабуся ще дівчинкою, з чорним як смола волоссям і круглим обличчям.

«Я посивіла в сорок, — засміялася вона, — але волосся в мене досі густе!»

Потім вона показала мені фото, де тато ще немовля з пухкими щічками, а ще одне, де йому шістнадцять: довготелесий юнак зі скуйовдженим волоссям. Дивно було бачити його таким, бо тепер він лисіє.

Наостанок бабуся відкрила сторінку з фотографією своєї мами. «Знаєш, — сказала вона, — ти разюче схожа на неї». Я придивилася й усміхнулася. Вона мала рацію.
example.en:
Last Sunday my grandmother showed me an old photo album. On the first page was my great-grandfather, a [[portly gentleman|b2]] with a [[droopy moustache|a2]] and a kind smile. Next to him stood Grandma as a girl, with [[jet-black hair|a22]] and a [[round face|a1]].

'I [[went grey|a23]] at forty,' she laughed, 'but I've still got [[thick hair|a18]]!'

Then she showed me a photo of my dad as a baby with [[chubby cheeks|a20]], and another of him at sixteen: a [[lanky youth|b3]] with [[dishevelled hair|b4]]. It was strange to see him like that, because now he's [[going bald|a16]].

Finally, Grandma turned to a photo of her own mother. 'You know,' she said, 'you [[bear a striking resemblance to|b5]] her.' I looked closely and smiled. She was right.
